stateDefinitions.IDLE: No active complete Round; the next paid spin claims exactly one Redis member.
stateDefinitions.PAID_START_DELIVERED: Step 0 of one claimed Round was delivered; ba>0, ss=1 and nfsc=0.
stateDefinitions.FREE_DELIVERY_ACTIVE: The same claimed Round is active; continuation Steps have ba=0, gt=2, small_game_type=2 and monotonic nfsc.
stateDefinitions.TERMINAL: The claimed Round ends only when ss=1 and fsn=nfsc; final rwa is settled once and History is appended.

rulesHashBasis: SHA-256 of the current-game frontend rules/protocol bundle assets/main/index.76d7e.js

codec.formAlgorithm: encodeURIComponent(key/value), spaces encoded as +, pairs joined by &

responseEnvelope.success: HTTP 2xx and envelope code loosely equals 200; consumer receives data or {}
responseEnvelope.failure: non-2xx or envelope code != 200 rejects with the parsed envelope; non-JSON becomes {code: HTTP<status>, info: ''}

codec.secrets: Launch/session tokens are transport credentials and remain redacted in evidence; they are not a payload cipher.

requestOrder.action: iframe document and versioned static bundles

requestOrder.output: player, provider token, ping, rc, gc
bet lists, currency, defaults, paytable, optional last snapshot

endpoints.purpose: exchange launch session for provider player/token state
initialize game configuration and optional interrupted-Round snapshot
start a paid Round or deliver its next free Step

fieldSemantics.tis: transfer identifier selected for log-view; persisted only as SHA-256
fieldSemantics.gt: history game identifier; observed 45 and not the live-spin gt field

endpoints.purpose: history detail; client concatenates bsl and fsl

fieldSemantics.wmkl: history shape is an array of {psn,sk,wa,wpk}; frontend converts for rendering

endpoints.purpose: session heartbeat when verify.ping.enable is nonzero
timing telemetry; not required for game-state correctness

configFields.spl: symbol payout multipliers keyed by match length
configFields.last: optional interrupted-Round delivery snapshot; null in captured inactive session
configFields.ts: server timestamp/version-like numeric field; behavior not used by current frontend code
configFields.frwa: optional all-free-win field consumed by frontend resume/history code; absent from all 2306 captured live Step responses
configFields.remove_num: optional frontend result field; absent from all 2306 captured live Step responses

spinRequest.continuationBehavior: the frontend sends the same bl/bs request shape for the next free Delivery; the server returns ba=0

spinResponseFields.ba: amount charged by this Step; 0.50 only at the paid Round start and 0 for all continuations
spinResponseFields.fsn: current total scheduled free-spin count; may increase on retrigger
spinResponseFields.gt: game-type discriminator; observed 1 on paid starts and 2 on free Steps
spinResponseFields.nfsc: number of free Steps delivered/consumed so far
spinResponseFields.rpx: free-spin payout multiplier; 0 ordinary, observed 2/5/8 in free mode
spinResponseFields.rskl: 15 visible symbol ids in column-major order: index = reel * 3 + row
spinResponseFields.rwa: cumulative award for the complete Round through this Step
spinResponseFields.small_game_type: UI submode discriminator; observed 0 on paid starts and 2 on free Steps
spinResponseFields.ss: Step status flag; 0 means continuation, 1 appears on the paid start and legal terminal; not sufficient alone to end a Round
spinResponseFields.wa: award contributed by this Step; all captured free transitions satisfy current.rwa - prior.rwa = wa
spinResponseFields.wmkl: winning-line map: line number 1..25 -> {symbolId: consecutiveMatchCount}; empty loss is []
spinResponseFields.frwa: optional all-free-win field consumed by frontend resume/history code; absent from all 2306 captured live Step responses
spinResponseFields.remove_num: optional frontend result field; absent from all 2306 captured live Step responses

boardAndWin.payoutFormula: spl[symbol][matchCount] * bs * bl * (containsWild ? 2 : 1) * (rpx == 0 ? 1 : rpx), summed across wmkl lines

roundDeliveryStateMachine.countingUnit: one paid Round, never one HTTP request or free Step
roundDeliveryStateMachine.start: IDLE -> PAID_START_DELIVERED only for a response with ba>0 and ss=1
roundDeliveryStateMachine.ordinaryTerminal: paid response has fsn=nfsc=0 and ss=1
roundDeliveryStateMachine.freeTrigger: paid response has ba>0, ss=1, fsn>nfsc=0 and rpx in {2,5,8}; Round remains active
roundDeliveryStateMachine.freeContinuation: same roundId, ba=0, gt=2, small_game_type=2, nfsc advances by one, ss=0 until final Delivery
roundDeliveryStateMachine.retrigger: a free Delivery with 3/4/5 Scat increases fsn by 8/12/20 while nfsc continues monotonically
roundDeliveryStateMachine.terminal: ss=1 AND fsn==nfsc; both conditions are required
roundDeliveryStateMachine.settlement: rwa accumulates wa; intermediate free balances remain held and terminal balance increases by final rwa
roundDeliveryStateMachine.generationBoundary: downstream GameRuleCore must generate the complete Round once; Delivery only consumes its ordered Steps
roundDeliveryStateMachine.indexBoundary: spin-index.jsonl contains only the paid start and associates all continuation Steps with the same roundId

sequence: paid spin activates FREE_SPINS with fsn=8,nfsc=0
config returns non-null last matching activation
eight ba=0 spin deliveries advance nfsc 1..8
sessionResume.codeBehavior: frontend converts last.wmkl entries {wpk,sk,psn} to the live map, restores the snapshot, and treats fsn!=nfsc as active content
sessionResume.terminationRule: resume remains active while fsn!=nfsc; legal terminal is ss==1 && fsn==nfsc

errorBranches.transport: timeout/error rejects; malformed response becomes HTTP<status>
errorBranches.spinUi: on failure, current auto-spin is cancelled and play lock is released after error handling

sequence: POST log-list page_index=2 or observe end
historyContract.listPaginationTermination: page 2 is captured as the required adjacent next-page response; continue or stop according to the returned end/ll state consumed by the frontend
historyContract.transferRule: the selected list tis and detail transfer_id must match; evidence stores the same SHA-256 value, never the raw identifier

implementationV3.core: Shared Java GameRuleCore; production CorePayout separately verified by ResultUtil
implementationV3.model: Compiled empirical joint special-symbol shape and conditional three-cell reel windows; 1306 training rounds, 100 excluded holdout rounds
implementationV3.memberEncoding: R45C3|initialFree|multiplier|ordered 15-hex-character boards; printable ASCII; no bet or response JSON

redis.zeroAwardFree: special:0 selected only from LOSS branch
redis.claim: Choose WIN/LOSS first; choose mode; WIN chooses existing positive integer index; atomically LPOP exactly one member; no fallback
redis.continuation: Persist complete decoded round; all deliveries use same roundKey and ordered steps

implementationV3.historyIdentifiers: Original evidence identifiers were redacted; compact stable local opaque IDs are projected consistently for list/detail; no original ID format claim.
